_doc: Declarative tuning surface for the dispatch pipeline. Edit values here to fine-tune WORK SELECTION (which issue is picked) and PROMPT GENERATION (how the work order reads) without touching Python. Loaded by services/tuning.py, which deep-merges this file over baked-in defaults — so a missing or partial file still works (and reproduces current behavior). Keys beginning with '_' are documentation and ignored by the loader. Override the file path with the DISPATCH_TUNING_FILE env var. Determinism is a hard requirement: changing a value changes the work order, but two runs with the same config stay byte-identical.

selection._doc: Knobs that decide WHICH issue gets worked: the classifier's triage signals and the ranker's dependency parse.

classify._doc: Deterministic keyword triage. hints: substrings (lowercased match) that signal scope/action. conf: the confidence formula weights. scope_route: scope -> generation route.

conf._doc: conf = base + scope_signal_weight*min(#scope-hints, scope_signal_cap) + (body_long_bonus if len(body)>=body_long_threshold) - vague_weight*min(#vague-hints, vague_cap) - (body_short_penalty if len(body)<body_short_threshold); clamped to [clamp_min, clamp_max], rounded to round_ndigits. A 'duplicate?' action is then capped at dup_cap.

ranker._doc: Offline deterministic dependency parse. Regexes (each with one (\d+) capture group) that find issue cross-references in title+body. Markdown emphasis is stripped and matching is MULTILINE before these apply. fwd = 'this issue depends on #N' (incl. an epic body task-listing a constituent '- [ ] #N'). rev = 'this issue unblocks/blocks #N' (=> #N depends on this issue) — incl. a child naming its 'parent epic: #N', which makes the epic depend on (rank after) the child.

generation._doc: Knobs that shape the emitted work order: budgets, decomposition/staffing, embedded resources, and rendering.

approval._doc: scope_budget: total tokens ADMIN authorizes per scope. phase_split: [phase, fraction] pairs; the remainder (~0.20) is held as contingency reserve.

decompose._doc: swarm_max: hard cap on agents (= number of units). specialization_rules: ordered; first matching rule names the unit's specialist as '<domain> <function>'. A rule fires if ANY condition in 'any' is true; an 'all_of' condition is an AND group. Conditions match the lowercased repo-relative path (path_*) or its basename (basename_*). The final rule has "default": true.

resources._doc: Caps for the self-contained embedding. max_files: referenced files embedded (rest are listed, not embedded). cap_bytes: bytes per referenced file. contract_cap / schema_cap: bytes for CLAUDE.md and the invoice schema.

workorder._doc: Rendering knobs. route_alias maps a route to the model alias used by the opt-in --llm sharpen path. box_width is the header box width in columns.
